_switches: enabled: off, nothing here is read. touchBuilt: the rows for today's five classes (paving, rock, soil, sand, rubble) in landing and craters are read only when this is true, so a world without the new biomes plays as today with the file on
_about: PARKED (Combat, 2026-10-23; docs/combat/biomes.md section 4). Choreography atoms that read the ground, keyed by World's surface class: the skid-stop a body makes when it is carried along the ground, how a recoil exit's landing changes, the approach's first steps, and the slam crater's shape. The rule over all of it (Orb's press feel, melee-press-feel.md): the ground changes distances, looks and the world, never when a press the brawl would take is taken. Two things the ground decides already hold control today, and the proposals that move them are Game Design's to rule: a carried body's journey (control returns when the journey ends, so a lower brake returns it later) and an embed (World's 60-tick down state when a slam digs deep enough). A recoil exit's landing slide comes after control has returned: momentum he can act out of. Its numbers that change the sim (brakes, crater factors, refill, embedMul, sunkMoveTicks, slideBh, tripAbove) need the replay's hash: in this file, or moved into contact.json, which WorldContact.dataHash already covers. surfaces: the classes World has (contact.json: paving, rock, soil, sand, rubble) and nine proposed, each with the class it reads as until World builds it, so this file works on today's world. World owns the surfaces' brakes and the craters; Animation the poses; VFX the trails and ejecta; Encounter picks the atoms and sends the events.

biomeSurface._about: proposed rows for World's contact.json biomeSurface for the new biomes (World's ids to come), and the two ice biomes that are aliased today. Settlements keep paving (contact.json paving). Aftermath strips override: glaze reads ice, ember reads crust, scree reads rubble, flood reads water

skidStop._about: how a body carried along the ground comes to rest: the upright slide of a short knock-back, the skid of a long one (World's slide on the feet), a guard's push-back. pose: Animation's stop (a shared pose with each fighter's flavour); trail: VFX's mark along the path; end: how he is left at rest; spin: true turns him through the slide so he ends square to the one who sent him. Distances are World's (the brake); nothing here holds a press

mud._sunk: movement waits 6 ticks while he pulls his feet out; presses are taken as ever

litter._trip: above this speed (units a second, unboosted) a root catches a foot: a stumble into a roll, ending on a knee. A look inside the stop's own distance and time, never a tumble

water._note: World's water rules decide skim or sink; this is the look of the stop

landing._about: how a recoil exit's landing (data/anim/recoil.json kinds: skip, handspring, tuck, backflip) changes by surface. slideBh: he lands into a slide this long (momentum after control returns); sinkBh: his feet sink this far (a look); burst: VFX's puff at the touch-down. Missing classes land as today

water._note: a landing on water is World's: skim or sink

approach._about: the first steps of a dash or a zip from the ground: a look, not a speed. Missing classes start as today

craters._about: the slam crater's shape by surface, for World's crater (sim/world/crater.gd dig, contact.json embed). Every factor multiplies today's bowl: radius, depth, rim (the berm), steep (the wall's slope). refill: the share of the depth that fills back, over refillTicks (sand and ash slump, mud closes, snow drifts). embedMul: times the depth a slammed body embeds (contact.json embed). cracks: Rendering's decal; ejecta: VFX's. fill: water that stands in the bowl. Missing classes dig today's bowl. Depth and embedMul change how often a slam reaches World's embed threshold (contact.json embed.minDepthBh): snow and mud more often, ice, sand and rock less; an embed is a 60-tick down state, so the shift is Game Design's to rule

ice._breakThrough: on sea ice, a bowl deeper than the floe breaks it into plates and opens water under him (World's floes)

litter._treesLean: trees within this many crater radii lean outward (World's props)

events._about: what Encounter sends so Animation, VFX, Camera and Audio can read the ground. Both ride today's events where one exists

skid_stop.sentAt: when the carried body starts its stop; rides World's slide event when it is a skid

ground_land.sentAt: a recoil exit's touch-down; rides the recoil cue's land tick

crater_shape.sentAt: World's crater event gains the surface and the shape it dug
